a.text: Being upfront with you: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until the reserve hits 8 almost guarantees the episode ends before anyone gets cells. The reserve holds only 4, so just one of us can be safe after round 1. I plan to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it puts you at risk. If there's another round, I'll operate every round, and I won't take anything more, so the reserve can build up for you.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
